title: I created a creatures collector game
author: Maximum-Cover3424
selftext:
Hey everyone, I just wanted to share the game I started to create during this week and slowly adding more and more features.

This game is about a collecting creatures in the wild that spawn randomly (and also divided by biomes too) and to have full data of each species you must scanning them multiple times, some of the is just 2 times others requires 10. Also there’s a lower percentage of spotting the shinny version! (Is visible during the video).   
Apart from this you have npc with some short stories and missions to bring some amount of creature in order to get some coins to be used in some stores to buy new gear to catch special creatures or to go to another biomes (mountain, deserts, etc).   
Also another way to get some coins y ofc by scanning the creatures, so there’s a natural progression because once almost complete a place you can go to another one or keep looking for those rare shinny variants.

I added a bloc with some details about each creature with details and shinny variations, but all the info it will be appears the more you scan them, same as the shinny version, you’ll not be able to see it if you don’t spot it first in the wild. 

The wild is some kind of procedural place with trees, lakes, rock and different sizes and variations depending on the biomes. Apart from this, from time to time it rains (including some thunderstorms) and there’s day/night cycles (some creatures appears only at night for example).

The look and feel of the game is on purpose with this low poly pixelated style, but the idea is to improve the quality to be more close to the game “A short hike”, same with the UI for now is just basic structure.

Oh also it can be played in any mobile or desktop screen. I hope you like it!   
By the way, all made with Claude Sonnet 5.5 if you’re curious.
